Hi Rachel — appreciate the heads up and the attachment. Quick summary from our side: the order form you sent references the same commercial terms as the MSA we executed, but the signatory name/entity does not match the legal name in Ariba. Two pragmatic options we can pursue: 

1) Portal fix: we can map the Ariba vendor profile to accept delegated signers if you can provide a signatory matrix or PO acceptance authority doc from your finance team. This avoids re-signing but requires procurement/legal evidence from Stable Supply. I can coordinate with Ops to make the mapping (takes 1–2 business days once we have the proof).

2) Document fix: amend the order form with a short confirmation clause that the signatory is an authorized representative of the legal entity named in the MSA (one-page amendment). Legal prefers this when entity names differ.

Kimberly / Marissa — tagging you for legal redline and activation checklist.

Rachel — which would you prefer? If option 1, please attach the signatory proof (signed pdf or internal delegation memo). If option 2, legal will circulate a 1-pg amendment and we can DocuSign.

Best,
